fields.meta_title: Chiropractic Landing Page Builder for Bookings | Emergent
fields.meta_description: A chiropractic landing page turns one visit into a booking request. See four clinic examples and build one with a short form and a call button.
fields.h1: Build a Chiropractic Landing Page That Takes Bookings
fields.hero_description: Get a chiropractic landing page that books first visits by clinic and day, with each request saved to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: What a Clinic Page Needs to Book a First Visit
fields.features_subheading: Six parts carry a visitor from the first screen to a booking request, and Emergent changes any of them by prompt.
fields.feature_1:
Four fields and a send button

The form asks for a name, a phone number, the clinic, and the day that suits the visitor. Emergent builds it from your prompt, and adding a field takes one more message.
fields.feature_2:
A call button sized for a thumb

Put the clinic's number in a button on the first screen, where a visitor on a phone can dial without scrolling. Repeat that same number in the footer, area code included.
fields.feature_3:
Every request kept as a row

Each booking request becomes a row in a database you own, with the clinic, the preferred day, and the time it arrived. Staff call back in the order the rows came in.
fields.feature_4:
An email the moment a request lands

Choose who hears about a new request: an email to the front desk, a Slack message to the office manager, or both. The app sends it with the visitor's name and number.
fields.feature_5:
Hours and parking next to the form

Show the clinic's hours and street address beside the booking form, with a line on where to park. A visitor choosing between two days can check both without leaving the page.
fields.feature_6:
A web address patients recognize

Publish the page on a domain the clinic already owns, such as a booking subdomain of the main site patients know. Custom domains are included in Emergent and use credits.
fields.why_description: Name the clinics and who calls back, and Emergent builds the page. Requests sit in a table you own, and paid plans export the code.

fields.tab_content_1:
A Harlow Road request goes to Wen

Juniper Point Chiropractic runs clinics on Harlow Road, Bay Street, and Fenwick Square, and its page asks the visitor to pick one first. A request for Harlow Road emails Wen Hollis at that front desk, and the other two clinics get their own. Last week 64 requests came in, and 29 of them picked Harlow Road.
fields.tab_content_2:
Saturday fills up with 12 requests

Saltmarsh Chiropractic opens from 8 am to noon on Saturdays and offers 12 first-visit slots. The form shows how many are left, and a visitor who sees Saturday running low can pick a weekday. This week 9 slots are taken and 3 remain. Once the twelfth request arrives, Saturday drops off the list of days on the form.
fields.tab_content_3:
17 of 42 requests came in Spanish

Alder Vista Chiropractic runs the same page in English and in Spanish, and each request records the version it came from. This month 25 requests came from the English page and 17 from the Spanish one. Every Spanish row lands on Lucia Paredes's call-back list, and she returns those calls in Spanish.
fields.tab_content_4:
A 6 pm email reaches each booked patient

The front desk at Hollin Creek Chiropractic marks a request Booked and adds the visit time. At 6 pm the evening before, the app emails the patient the time, the street address, and the parking note. Ines Kowal is booked for Thursday at 9:30 am, and her reminder went out Wednesday at 6 pm.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Chiropractic Landing Page
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to a chiropractic landing page that books first visits at every clinic and leaves health questions to intake.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Decide who the page is for
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Make the call button easy to tap
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Keep health questions off the form
fields.howto_step_1_des: Write the page for a new patient booking a first visit, and send returning patients to the clinic's main site. Someone who clicked an ad for a first visit should find that visit and its form, with no menu of other services.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Say how long the first visit lasts and what it costs, if the clinic charges one set price for it. Put both next to the form, where a visitor reads them before choosing a day, and keep the wording the same in your ads.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Size the call button for a thumb. Chrome's Lighthouse docs say tap targets that are 48 px by 48 px never fail the audit. In the page's markup, Google asks you to include the country code and area code in the phone number.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Ask only what the front desk needs to call back and set a time. Leave health history and the reason for the visit to the intake paperwork the clinic sends after booking, where staff already handle it.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Give every clinic its own hours
fields.howto_step_5_des: List each location with its own street address and hours. Google's local business guidance says to define each local business location as a LocalBusiness type. Mark up each clinic as a separate entry.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Label every field on the form
fields.howto_step_6_des: Give each field a visible label, such as Preferred day, instead of gray text inside the box. WCAG 2.1 success criterion 3.3.2 reads: labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Build it and send a test request
fields.howto_step_7_des: Describe the clinics and who hears about each request, and Emergent builds it from that description. Send one test request per clinic from a phone, then check the row in your database and the email at the front desk.

faq_plan.q: What is a chiropractic landing page?
faq_plan.a: A chiropractic landing page is a single web page that asks a visitor to request one kind of visit at a chiropractic clinic, such as a first visit for new patients. It pairs that offer with a short booking form under a call button, and leaves the clinic's other pages out of the way.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a chiropractic landing page?
faq_plan.a: Decide which visit the page books and which clinics take requests, then describe both to Emergent's AI landing page builder, along with the form fields and who should hear about each request. Emergent builds the page and its database from that prompt, and you change it by prompting again.

faq_plan.q: How many chiropractic landing pages should a clinic with several locations have?
faq_plan.a: Start with one page and a clinic picker when every location sells the same first visit. Give a location its own page once its offer, hours, or ads differ. Each ad can then point at the clinic it names. Emergent builds a second page from a prompt, and splitting one off later takes one message.

faq_plan.q: Should a chiropractic landing page ask whether the visitor has insurance?
faq_plan.a: Yes, with one plain question: will the visitor use insurance or pay on their own. Leave plan names and member IDs for the intake paperwork after booking. The insurance example on the dentist landing page opens with the same pay-first question, and the answer tells the front desk what to check before calling back.

faq_plan.q: Should the form on a chiropractic landing page have a notes box?
faq_plan.a: No. Anything typed in an open box is saved with the request, including details the front desk does not need to set a time. Offer fixed choices instead, such as the clinic and the preferred day, and let the intake paperwork collect the rest.

faq_plan.q: How do I show Saturday or evening hours on a chiropractic landing page?
faq_plan.a: Print the extra hours beside the form and offer them as choices on it, with the number of slots left when they are capped. In structured data, Google's guidance reads: use both the validFrom and validThrough properties to define seasonal hours. Add that date range when Saturday hours run for part of the year only.

faq_plan.q: Should chiropractic ads point to the clinic website or a chiropractic landing page?
faq_plan.a: Point them to the chiropractic landing page. Build it around the one offer and the one form the ad promised, and keep the clinic website for visitors who want to browse every service. A product landing page works the same way, built around one item and one button.

faq_plan.q: How do I make a chiropractic landing page in Spanish and English?
faq_plan.a: Write the Spanish page as its own version instead of a word-for-word copy, and have a fluent speaker read it before it goes live. Put a switch between the two versions at the top of the page. Requests from a page Emergent builds are stored in a database you own, and each row can carry the version it came from.

faq_plan.q: How do I track which ads bring booking requests to a chiropractic landing page?
faq_plan.a: Add a tag to each ad's link, such as the campaign name, and have the form save that tag with every request in a hidden field. Count requests by tag each week, and move budget toward the ads whose requests turn into booked visits. Emergent adds the hidden field when you ask for it in the prompt.

faq_plan.q: What should a chiropractic landing page do when first-visit slots are full?
faq_plan.a: Offer the next open day on the form, and let visitors who wanted the full day leave a name and number for a cancellation. A waitlist landing page runs on the same idea: take contact details now and call when a spot opens. Say on the page when the front desk calls people on that list.

plan.angle: Searchers for chiropractic landing page see template galleries and website-design roundups that show how a clinic page looks, never how a booking request moves from the page to the front desk. This page shows four chiropractic landing pages built around booking logistics only (picking one of three clinic locations, a capped run of Saturday first-visit slots, an English and Spanish version of one page, a reminder email the evening before a booked visit), each with the form, the routing and the database row behind it, and gives the build steps a clinic owner needs: one offer, a call button sized for a thumb, health questions left to the clinic's own intake, every location listed with its own hours. It makes no treatment or health claims. Dentist, telehealth and mental health pages are siblings and stay out of the headings; fitness is a different cluster.
